posts.en:
dsh-email-push-master is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Email reminders from your DSH agent when you are away, with stable SMTP (no 535 retry loop), connect and idle timeouts, and a --check self-test.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b6102863b8e2a01ebd15.html
